final: WITH s1 AS (SELECT t.tradekind AS k, COUNT(*) AS c FROM advancedbehavior a JOIN transactionrecord r ON r.transreg = a.translink JOIN trader t ON t.tradereg = r.trdref GROUP BY t.tradekind), s2 AS (SELECT SUM(c) AS tot FROM s1), s3 AS (SELECT s1.k AS k, s1.c AS c, CAST(s1.c AS REAL) / s2.tot AS share FROM s1 JOIN s2 ON s2.tot IS NOT NULL), s4 AS (SELECT AVG(c) AS av FROM s3), s5 AS (SELECT s3.k, s3.c, s3.share, s3.c - s4.av AS d FROM s3 JOIN s4 ON s4.av IS NOT NULL WHERE s3.c > s4.av) SELECT SUM(c), AVG(share), AVG(d) FROM s5
